tasks.subject: Task 1: Pure integrity checker
tasks.description:
**Goal:** checkIntegrity(pages, env) → precise error strings for missing images, dead internal links, unknown anchors, malformed external URLs; collectAnchors derives fragments from content + EXTRA_ANCHORS; ROUTE_BY_PAGE maps page names to routes.

**Files:** Create scripts/lib/content-check.mjs; Test scripts/lib/content-check.test.mjs

**Acceptance Criteria:** valid fixture → []; missing image/dead route/unknown fragment/malformed external each error with path+file; collectAnchors merges content ids + EXTRA_ANCHORS; no node:fs import.

**Verify:** node --test scripts/lib/content-check.test.mjs (6 tests)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/lib/content-check.mjs", "scripts/lib/content-check.test.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "node --test scripts/lib/content-check.test.mjs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["valid → []", "each breakage errors with path+file", "anchors merged", "pure module"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: CLI gate + wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** npm run content:check composes sync → integrity with fs-derived env (public/ listing, app/**/page.tsx route discovery); builds run it automatically; stray .tasks.json untracked.

**Files:** Create scripts/check-content.mjs, scripts/check-content.test.mjs; Modify scripts/sync-content.mjs (additive pages key), package.json, .gitignore

**Acceptance Criteria:** runCheck ok/stage semantics with sync short-circuit; CLI non-zero + all errors, Windows-safe; runSync existing tests pass unmodified; build/export/netlify-build wired + test:content extended; git ls-files docs/superpowers empty.

**Verify:** node --test scripts/check-content.test.mjs && npm run test:content && npm run content:check

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/check-content.mjs", "scripts/check-content.test.mjs", "scripts/sync-content.mjs", "package.json", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "node --test scripts/check-content.test.mjs && npm run test:content && npm run content:check", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ok/stage semantics", "CLI exit codes", "runSync additive", "wiring", "tasks.json untracked"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: End-to-end verification of the gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the gate is green on real content, fails loudly on live negative tests (broken image path, broken anchor), and the repo stays healthy.

**Files:** none (verification; local continuation.md note).

**Acceptance Criteria:** build 8/8 via content:check; negative A (image typo in interests.md) exits 1 naming file+path then restores green; negative B (#explor anchor in home.md) exits 1 with unknown-anchor then restores green; Jest 36/36 + test:content pass; clean tree.

**Verify:** npm run build && npm test && npm run test:content && npm run content:check && git diff --quiet content/

```json:metadata
{"files": [], "verifyCommand": "npm run build && npm test && npm run test:content && npm run content:check && git diff --quiet content/", "acceptanceCriteria": ["build 8/8", "negative A loud fail + restore", "negative B loud fail + restore", "suites green", "clean tree"]}
```
